text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Alert - HTTP 500 and malformed token outputs on /v1/generate (text-gen-v5). Errors spike 22% in last 3m. Affected route: /api/generate/prod. Dashboard: https://dashboard.redwood/alerts/5105559876

maria.ops: I'm oncall. Seeing garbled UTF tokens & high latency. Paging @jake.sre and @tanya.eng

jake.sre: oncall ack. Canaries show tokenizer OOV errors up 30% and 'invalid token' logs. Quick check: deployed model_alias 'v5-release' points to weightset id 0x7fab... but artifact checksum in registry is for 'v5-fp16' — mismatch. suspect alias flip during promotion.

tanya.eng: I pushed the pipeline change earlier that promoted 'v5-release' automatically. Confirming envvar MODEL_ALIAS was set to "auto/latest" in deploy job. This could have chosen an unintended artifact. Rolling flags now.

incidents-bot: Deploy bot recorded feature flag flip: release.public_v5=true at 2026-03-15T12:34:02Z by tanya.eng

maria.ops: Executing kill-switch: turning off public canary traffic and routing to fallback 'v4-stable'.

jake.sre: Running command to reroute traffic:
```
# route traffic away from canary
curl -X POST https://router.internal/set-route -d '{"route":"/api/generate/prod","model":"text-gen-v4","percent":100}'
```

sam.cs: Support report: 3 enterprise customers complaining of truncated and nonsensical outputs; ticket IDs: #INC-4321, #INC-4322, #INC-4323. Notifying account teams.

tanya.eng: Patching pipeline to pin alias and validate checksum before promotion. Planned PR: fixes/deploy-pin-alias, will add pre-promotion checksum validation and a dry-run alias-resolve step.

jake.sre: Rollback in progress: promote 'v5-stable-2026-03-10' to prod and re-deploy gateway config. ETA ~5m. Monitoring logs for tokenization error rate.

maria.ops: Rollback completed at 12:40:15Z. Service 200s restored. Tokenization errors dropped from 22% -> 1.8% in 6m. Customers still being checked.

tanya.eng: Postmortem items: 1) fix pipeline alias pin + checksum gate, 2) add canary validation test for tokenizer output drift, 3) add an alert on artifact alias mismatch. I'll own the PR and follow up.

jake.sre: Handing off to daytime oncall @tanya.eng for postmortem and customer follow-up. Adding notes to incident tracker: https://incidents.redwood/5105559876

maria.ops: Closing rotation. If anyone sees residual user errors ping here. :white_check_mark:
